topic: A camping trip by the lake
coach_rationale: 今天继续本周重点：过去式动词结尾 -ed/-t/-d 的听辨，passage 里埋了 set off、put up、look up、pack up 等 6 组短语动词连读做靶子。EnglishPod365 笔记自 10 月 16 日 EP0012 后没有更新，他暴露的主弱项仍是连读、省略和缩写时态，所以今天用露营这个新话题继续练同一批语言点。网站听写表仍为空、EnglishPod 新版也无错题记录，B1 难度有分样本仍只有 1 次，今天这篇继续补样本。
passage: Last Saturday, my friend and I decided to go camping by a lake outside the city. Although the weather report said it might rain at night, we packed our bags and set off early in the morning because we wanted to reach the lake before noon. We put up our tent near the water and collected dry wood for a fire. In the afternoon, we walked around the lake and looked for a good place to fish. My friend caught a small fish and laughed happily, and I took a photo of him with the lake behind him. When the sun went down, we lit a small fire and cooked noodles in a pot. We sat beside the fire and talked about our work and our plans for next year. The stars came out one by one, and we looked up at the sky for a long time. At midnight, we put out the fire and climbed into our sleeping bags. Although the ground felt hard, we slept well because the air smelled fresh and clean. The next morning, we woke up and packed up our tent. It was a short trip, but it helped us forget our busy week.

收拾、打包（to put things into bags to leave）
